# Análisis e diseño experimental

## Base de datos

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1usxzxsS2-eozwwrzBdO6IKGJsyDRpihZunrBrXrCQh4/edit?gid=2080506897#gid=2080506897

## Identificar los factores

1.Factor 1: Boro (B)
1.Factor 2: Potasio (k)

## Identificar el modelo

Factorial en DBCA
$$y = \mu + bloque + B + K + B*k + \xi$$


# Project setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')
```

## Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1usxzxsS2-eozwwrzBdO6IKGJsyDRpihZunrBrXrCQh4/edit?gid=2080506897#gid=2080506897" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "fb") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(trat,bloque,B,K), ~ as.factor(.))) %>%

  group_by(trat, bloque, B, K) %>%
  summarise(pdf = mean(pdf), .groups = "drop")

fb %>% str()

```
# Analisis de varianza

```{r}
md <- aov(
  pdf ~ bloque + B * K,
  data = fb
)

anova(md)
```

# comparación de medias

```{r}
mc <- emmeans(md, ~ B * K)

mc

# Letras de significancia de Tukey
tab <- multcomp::cld(
  mc,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  decreasing = TRUE
)

tab

```

# Representación gráfica

```{r}
pl <- plot_smr(data = tab,
               x = "B",
               y = "emmean",
               group = "K",
               error = "SE",
               sig = ".group",
               ylab = "Peso del fruto"
               )

pl

```
